# SK0217 — The discard declaration is not arranged

<!-- Generated from Rules/Rikarin.Skala.Rules.Metadata/rules.json. Do not edit. -->

`skala arrange` would use the configured explicit or implicit discard declaration.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | Formatting |
| Default severity | suggestion |
| Scope | Syntax |
| Needs a compilation | no |
| Fix | no |
| Language version floor | 7.0 |
| Since | 2.0 |

## Why

The cleanup preference chooses between `out _` and `out var _`. Both spell the same discard, but the change adds or removes syntax and therefore belongs to arrangement rather than formatting.

## Example

Instead of:

```csharp
TryRead(out var _);
```

Write:

```csharp
TryRead(out _);
```

## When it does not fire

Only discard designations are changed; named locals and typed non-discard declarations are preserved.

## Configuration

- `resharper_csharp_prefer_explicit_discard_declaration`
